title: ⚒️Build Contest & Updates
author: Jonathan Hill
excerpt: Hey everyone. Time to start our next build contest and announce a few more general updates! 🪔 Build Contest: Shrine
body:
Hey everyone. Time to start our next build contest and announce a few more general updates!

🪔Build Contest: Shrine

A holy place made to worship the divine. Many deities have recently touched our world; what do you worship?

  • 📅Due Date: Monday, June 16, 2025 1:59 AM (in your local time)

    • This event is also listed on the calendar, for those interested.

  • ✏️Prize & Submission Info: See ⁠⚒ Build Contest Overview

  • 🏆Special Prize: The top 3 entrants will receive +1 Charm slot and a unique charm themed to a Greek deity.

    • This charm will be released widely in the future, but these winners get first dibs.

📝General Updates

✏️Miscellaneous

  • Fixed standard color codes (such as &9 or &n) not working in text displays.

    • Note that text displays also support hex codes, e.g. <#ff0000> for red. This isn't new, but stating for visibility.

  • You are now auto-equipped with Swift Sneak V leggings in the creative world to help speed bridging while building.

    • This can be disabled with '/toggle creative_world swift_sneak' if desired.

  • By popular demand, the Greater Impact mcMMO Axes skill has been disabled.

  • Fixed the Potion Launcher not properly firing lingering potions.

📖Runecrafting

  • Equilibrium and Adrenaline Rush should more reliably catch your health when activated, and are less likely to get you stuck in a pseudo-death state.

  • Coyote Time should work as desired when sprinting down stairs or over grass/flowers.

  • Disabled ability to activate Rocket Boosting by jumping while ‘/fly’ is enabled as it conflicts too much with toggling flight.

Thanks friends!🫶
